title: Port identity and current scope
summary: ooRexx interpreter to MVS 3.8J is an experimental S/370 port of the interpreter itself. The dev16 190/199 C++ unit translation frontier remains inherited through dev20. The experimental Mainframe ELF SDK TSO31 and TSO24 lanes are separate; neither is a qualified running ooRexx on z/OS.
invariants: Do not equate 190 successful host translation units with an MVS-linked interpreter.
Do not mix the MVS 3.8J / 24-bit effective address contract with z/OS31 or z/OS64 ABI and service contracts.
Alchemy component PA-C-MVSCF is ACTIVE in the portfolio; a proposed conference paper PA-P-MVSCF is not production acceptance.
The sphere describes source and evidence; it grants no deployment or JES authority.
